title: 嵌入式互連橋整合
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入嵌入式矽橋局部細密互連與封裝邊界；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine embedded silicon-bridge fine interconnects and package boundaries. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。本課以公開 EMIB 架構說明局部桥接；不同世代的供電、TSV 及互連能力須看原始資料，不能混稱所有橋接方案相同。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Public EMIB architecture illustrates local bridges; power, TSV and interconnect capabilities vary by generation and must not be conflated.

stages.title: 局部橋接架構
stages.description: 本階段處理局部橋接架構：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address local bridge architecture through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 比較局部與全面中介層
steps.objective: 建立「比較局部與全面中介層」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：局部橋只在需要高密度連線處配置矽互連。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for compare local and full interposers: A local bridge places silicon routing only where dense links are needed.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫兩晶粒間的橋及其餘有機基板。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw a bridge between two dies and the surrounding substrate. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫兩晶粒間的橋及其餘有機基板。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw a bridge between two dies and the surrounding substrate. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：矽橋等於覆蓋整包的矽中介層。本步先檢查「比較局部與全面中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到局部橋只在需要高密度連線處配置矽互連。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A silicon bridge equals a full-package silicon interposer. First check whether evidence for compare local and full interposers actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A local bridge places silicon routing only where dense links are needed.
steps.check: 交付「比較局部與全面中介層」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for compare local and full interposers, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「嵌入式互連橋整合」的「比較局部與全面中介層」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「接合線：失蹤的良率」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Compare local and full interposers” in “Embedded interconnect-bridge integration”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.objectiveEn: Test the compare local and full interposers model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。畫兩晶粒間的橋及其餘有機基板。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Draw a bridge between two dies and the surrounding substrate. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：所有橋接世代都完全沒有 TSV。本步先檢查「比較局部與全面中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到局部橋只在需要高密度連線處配置矽互連。所指出的物理限制。

If not, revisit the physical constraint: A local bridge places silicon routing only where dense links are needed.
steps.check: 交付「比較局部與全面中介層」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for compare local and full interposers: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.title: 分配晶粒邊緣頻寬
steps.objective: 建立「分配晶粒邊緣頻寬」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：可用邊緣長與焊墊配置限制資料通道，不只看矽面積。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for allocate shoreline bandwidth: Available edge length and pad layout limit lanes, not only silicon area.
steps.instruction:
先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。驗算 80 個接點的幾何例。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

假設晶粒邊緣長 4 mm、單列有效接點間距 50 μm，幾何上限為 80 個接點；若保留 20% 給接地與備援，剩 64 個資料接點。這不是任何 EMIB 產品規格。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Check the 80-site geometric example. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

For a hypothetical 4 mm edge and 50 μm single-row effective pitch, the geometric limit is 80 sites; reserving 20% for ground/spares leaves 64 data sites. This is not an EMIB specification.

steps.title: 定義橋接界面：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Define bridge interfaces: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「定義橋接界面」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the define bridge interfaces model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。對照兩端焊墊圖及信號方向。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compare pad maps and signal direction at both ends. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：對照兩端焊墊圖及信號方向。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare pad maps and signal direction at both ends. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：所有橋接世代都完全沒有 TSV。本步先檢查「定義橋接界面」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到橋兩端焊墊、晶粒凸塊和基板路徑需共同匹配。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Every bridge generation is entirely TSV-free. First check whether evidence for define bridge interfaces actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Bridge pads, die bumps and substrate paths must match.
steps.check: 交付「定義橋接界面」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for define bridge interfaces: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.
